notes: Reads files your agency exports; it does not log in to your agency system, a carrier portal, a premium finance company or a bank.
Export layouts for Applied Epic, AMS360, Sagitta, HawkSoft, EZLynx and QQCatalyst were written from knowledge of each system and are confirmed on your own files during setup.
Commission schedules, split percents, bonus grids, state continuing-education hours and deadlines are settings your agency writes and confirms; they are not a carrier's rule or a state's law.
A finding is a lead for a licensed person to check, not a conclusion about coverage, a client or an employee.
Book valuation figures are a summary of your files, not an appraisal or a price.
warn: Your exports, reports and drafts stay on your computer; client names, birth dates, licence numbers and addresses are masked before anything reaches an AI model. No agent binds, cancels, endorses or recommends coverage, pays a carrier or producer, moves trust money, issues a certificate or sends a message.
